blocks.text: Actor Joseph Marco marked his birthday this year by spending time with nearly 600 rescued animals at a shelter. Marco, who turned 38 on Oct. 4, shared photos from the celebration on Instagram on Saturday, showing him posing with rescued cats and dogs, including some animals with injuries. He and his supporters also distributed food packs to the animals. “Celebrated my birthday today surrounded by almost 600 beautiful souls. My heart is so full,” Marco wrote. “The greatest gift is being able to give love, even in the smallest ways. Truly a birthday I’ll never forget.” The actor thanked his supporters, […]...
